status_message: Sketchware AI v2.1.3 is required: backups upload in parallel and resume by themselves after a lost connection, Restore shows one card per project, the Play Store page fits on one screen, and tabs open faster. Tap Update: it installs over this version and your projects stay.
update_reason: This update is required: it fixes problems in the version you have, and that version is no longer supported. It installs over it: your projects, settings and GitHub sign-in stay.
update_notes: Backups upload in parallel parts and resume by themselves
Restore: one card per project with its versions; Pin keeps one in front
Play Store: Follow creators, Review, Publish from the header
update_fixes: A finished Retry no longer leaves the old "Didn't work" notice
Tabs open faster; sizes in MB as Android counts them
The e-mailed sign-in code helper shows on GitHub's sign-in pages
